text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Since we had the day off, ya know? I 
thought I'd whip up a desk or some other 
simple thing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ruler in one hand, sketching out the 
blueprints... I was wondering, 'Like this? 
Or like this?' and then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Mr. Sun is saying hello! ...Or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, how am I gonna build this? At this 
rate, my favorite saw's gonna rust away.

Looking visibly drowsy, Inari One 
continued to rack her brains.
